headline: Weathered Expanse Exchanges Flare as Linn of Mercy Casualties Mount
war_summary: Weathered Expanse has reignited with six base exchanges across the past two hours, sustaining fierce clashes around Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance despite casualty tempos moderating from earlier peaks. Along the Nevish Line, immediate structural transfers have paused following intense earlier fighting, though frontline bloodshed remains heavy with hourly losses accelerating across Blackcoat Way and Princefal. The central meat grinder at Linn of Mercy has escalated into the conflict's bloodiest theater, where combined casualties now exceed fourteen hundred per hour as forces battle over Lathair without further ground changing hands. Disputed sectors in Kuura Strand, Marban Hollow, and Godcrofts have settled into a lull with no base movements in the last two hours, while Stlican Shelf experiences rising casualty rates and Callahan's Passage reports localized skirmishing. Across the broader map, the Dead Lands have further cooled, and rearward supply territories on both sides report negligible enemy contact.
